There is an example of synthesis and results of experimental study given in the article. The study of the proposed method based on the real control algorithm of the onboard computing device. Experiments and testing performed for various Intel (Altera) microchips. The studies carried out for different families of FPGAs, in different price ranges. A comparative analysis of time characteristics for the basic and proposed structures allows us to notice a tendency to some acceleration of the operation. In general, research results have shown that proposed structures of combined FSM can be useful for design of embedded systems.

articleTitle: Method for Choosing a Set of Data Protection Tools in Computer Networks of an Environmental Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Environmental monitoring systems are reviewed. A general statement of the problem of choosing a set of information protection tools in computer networks for the environmental monitoring system has been developed. The method of analyzing hierarchies gained further development due to its extension to a new class of objects – the selection of information protection tool sets according to many criteria in conditions of interval uncertainty of the initial information.

articleTitle: Application for Efficient Management of Renewable Electrical Energy Using Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article describes the developed information system for the efficient use of renewable energy sources, which provides storage of meteorological information and decision-making on the appropriateness of using an energy source. The calculation of the power of the generated energy, as well as its forecasting, is performed on the basis of the ARIMA model. The database is built on a relational data model; the programming language PHP and the phpMyAdmin database management system were used to develop the program. The Internet services Google Map API (to determine the location coordinates of the recovery sources of electricity in a settlement) and Weatherbit.io (to determine the weather) were also used.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models of Human-Computer Interaction. Analysis of Human Operator Activity in Terms of Error Generation and Problem Elimination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper deals with the task of modeling the processes of occurrence and elimination of errors in control systems and assessment of indicators of reliability. The model of building a functional network, which describes the interaction of a human-operator and computer, was chosen as the main concept. A method for the analytical evaluation of the reliability and time indicators of the control process based on the construction of a system of typical models for activity is proposed. A system for imitation modeling of man-computer interaction (when the creation of an analytical model is very difficult, or for correctness analysis of an analytical model) has been developed. The computer technology for the reliability analysis of man-computer system has been suggested. Examples of mathematical models and results of modeling a human-machine system in Matlab are given. The results can be useful in solving problems of ensuring reliability and searching for ergonomic reserves to increase efficiency of control systems.

articleTitle: The Method of Increasing the Immunity of Data Transmission in Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper determines the benefits and feasibility of a method for additional gating of digital counts in "sliding window" mode followed by additional gating of its responses in both quadrature signal channels at once. The method of two-stage additional gating of analog-to-digital converter counts during I/Q demodulation of digital signals is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research of Image Preprocessing Methods for Enhancement of Information Technology for Person Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Research presented in this paper describes the experiments conducted on image preprocessing methods, such as anisotropic diffusion and image histogram equalization, with an aim to enhance the performance of the information technology for person identification based on Gabor wavelet transform, local binary patterns in 1-dimensional space and histogram of oriented gradients for image processing, feature vector extraction, and classification. The experimental research of the algorithm was performed on three face image databases with the use of program software created in Python. Experiments were divided into three sets: the original set of the methods without preprocessing, set with the method of anisotropic diffusion, set with the method of image histogram equalization, and set with both these methods. Analysis of obtained results of the experimental research has shown that chosen methods haven’t provided the improvement of the algorithm, therefore other image preprocessing methods must be considered for further exploring.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Responder Capacity of the Indication Channel of Near Navigation Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work, the capacity of the transponders of the indication channel of short-range navigation systems is estimated under the action of intra-system and intentional correlated and uncorrelated interference in the request channel, based on the presentation of the indication channel of short-range navigation systems as an open single-channel queuing system with failures. It is shown that the implementation of time gating of the incoming signals "indication request" with a time gate for receiving the response signals of the range of radio beacons can reduce the intensity of the formation of response signals and, as a result, increase the throughput of the indication channel.

articleTitle: Selection of Informative Parameters Based on the Assessment of the Degree of Chaos of the Time Series of Observations During the Study of Complex Signals and Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Currently, prevention and treatment of ulcer disease occupy a rather important place among many problems faced by specialists, and the increasing prevalence of this disease is explained by the increase of environmental and stress factors. Investigations conducted to detect gastrointestinal tract motility disorders are difficult to analyze invasively. In this regard, simple non-invasive methods of functional diagnostics such as peripheral electrogastroenterography are of particular importance. Thus, recording the electrical potential of the gastrointestinal tract allows to evaluate its motor-evacuation function. Numerous studies have shown that there is a close interaction between the electrical and collecting activities of the gastrointestinal tract. Electrogastroenterography is a noninvasive method, has no contraindications and is well tolerated by patients. This allows even very serious patients to be examined both during surgery and in the first hours after surgery. Considering the simplicity and accuracy of this methodology, it is possible to conduct a large number of repeated studies in the assessment of the dynamics of parameters during the treatment process. The indicators obtained because of electrogastroenterography do not contradict each other and in many cases precede the results of radiological and endoscopic examination, which indicates that the considered method is superior in diagnosing the motility-evacuation function of the gastrointestinal tract. At this time, because of using modern computer technology, the timeliness and quality of diagnoses determined by a gastroenterologist significantly increases.

articleTitle: Module for Automatic Accounting of Consumed Cold and/or Hot Water Based on Wi-Fi Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work is devoted to the solution of the task of data acquisition automation for accounting of consumed water. In this work, the structure of the accounting module is proposed, which would be an addition to most of the currently used water meters. The operation principle of the developed module is based on the use of modern Internet technologies, and its main functions are taking pictures of water meter readings and sending them to an online database. The software necessary to transmit, save and display meter readings was also developed. It includes: server software implemented on the basis of the ASP.NET Core framework and the non-relational database MongoDB; client software implemented using Razor Pages technology; embedded software of the module itself is implemented using the library ESPAsyncWebServer. For conducting experimental studies, a device was used, which includes: OV2640 camera, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module ESP32-S, LED and memory card. The conducted studies showed the workability and effectiveness of the proposed approach to automating data collection of water meters.

articleTitle: The Method of Controlling The Wireless Sensor Network of Optical-Electronic Stations Using LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An analysis of modern technologies for the organization of wireless sensor networks using LoRa technology was carried out. Commands and an algorithm for controlling a wireless sensor network of optical-electronic stations were developed. Developed commands and algorithms allow to speed up and simplify the process of setting up EBYTE E32 radio modules, which are used as communication devices.

articleTitle: Development of a Navigation System on the University Territory Using Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: AR navigation is one of the interactive ways to use augmented reality. By displaying virtual guides in physical space using a smartphone, users can navigate from point to point more naturally than by comparing the map to their immediate environment. Thanks to this great advantage, AR navigation can help in searching both inside the academic building and on the territory of the institute. In this paper, the authors used 3DUnity and AR Foundation to create a navigation system around the territory of NTU "KhPI" using augmented reality technology. This development will allow you to navigate the terrain of the KhPI campus, find the location of the desired building, and also look the route from building to building on the map. The whole process is displayed on the smartphone screen. Real-time synchronization allows users in real world to feel virtual space, thereby enhancing poignancy and interaction, and making effect more vivid and almost real.

articleTitle: Application of the Method of Analysis of Hierarchies to Solve the Problem of Aircraft Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents the results of research using the method of analysis of hierarchies. This method, unlike the existing ones, allows comparing indicators of different nature in one decision-making plane. The selection of aircraft has been made. Characteristics and additional tactical and technical parameters are defined, which are divided into 5 groups in accordance with the indicators they describe. The calculation of integral quality indicators was carried out with the formation of a generalized global assessment criterion for each aircraft and unmanned aerial vehicle. A comparison of evaluation options was made for reference calculations and in accordance with the task being performed. The results of the calculations highlighted the advantages and disadvantages that should be paid attention to when choosing an aircraft.

articleTitle: CoLiTec Virtual Observatory Platform for the Cloud Computing Analysis of Light Curves for the Variable Stars
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A growing of the cloud services and resources capabilities allow moving the desktop software/applications to the servers/clouds/clusters. In this paper we have presented a brief description and several aspects related to the cloud computing, Virtual Observatory (VO) and Software as a Service (SaaS) in astronomy, reviewed them, and provided some major approaches of their realization in scope of the Collection Light Technology (CoLiTec) project as the SaaS called "CoLiTec Virtual Observatory Platform". We have presented a realization of the developed mathematical and computational methods related to the light curve creation of variable stars incapsulated into the CoLiTecVS (CoLiTec Variable Stars) desktop software as a new Software as a Service approach with the graphical user interface (GUI) in the cloud with web access and visualization. All processing stages are performed on the backend and end user has access to the web interface only. The CoLiTec Virtual Observatory Platform was successfully tested on the astronomical data with a lot of investigated variable stars of the different observatories in Ukraine, Slovakia and Thailand using the different types of telescopes and observational conditions.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Analysis of the Optimal Signal Detector in Interrogating Radio Engineering Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This document presents the synthesis and analysis of the optimal interrogation signal detector in aircraft transponders of interrogation radio engineering systems under the action in the interrogation channel of interrogation signal streams emitted both along the main and side lobes of the interrogator antenna, as well as deliberate uncorrelated and correlated interference. It is shown that taking into account the elements and their arrangements in the structure of the detector that evaluate the amplitudes of useful signals, as well as the excess of the amplitudes of superimposed interfering signals over them, makes it possible to stabilize the probability of false alarm when useful request signals are detected and, as a result, to improve the quality of detection of interrogation signals in aircraft responders.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Migration Impact on COVID-19 Dynamics in Slovakia by Machine Learning: Simulation Study during Russian War in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: COVID-19 has rapidly spread worldwide and has been a public health problem for more than two years. Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine launched on February 24, 2022, brought killings and injuries to Ukrainians and affected the spread of infectious diseases. The escalation of the war led to a migration crisis. Slovakia became one of the countries that accepted a large number of refugees. The study uses machine learning to assess the impact of refugees from Ukraine on the dynamics of the COVID-19 epidemic process in Slovakia. To do this, a simulation model was built to predict new cases and deaths from COVID-19 a month before the escalation of the war and in the first month after. The high accuracy of modeling for both periods suggests that the forced migration of the Ukrainian population to Slovakia is not a decisive factor in the increase in the incidence of COVID-19 in the country.

articleTitle: Jobs Distribution Task in Computer Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The technique of solving the distribution problem of the jobs (tasks) in the computer networks with the occurrence of failures has been considered in this article. The integer linear programming apparatus with Boolean variables based on the rank approach was used to solve the distribution problem of the jobs (tasks). This approach allows reducing the algorithmic complexity of the distribution problem of the jobs (tasks) to a significant degree.

articleTitle: Heart Failure Development Prediction using Stochastic Gradient Descent Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: More than 64 million people in the world suffer from heart failure. Automated diagnostic methods using machine learning are an effective tool to detect the disease at an early stage. The study aims to build a prediction model for patients with suspected heart failure based on the linear regression model optimized with stochastic gradient method. An open dataset of patients with suspected heart failure was used for the experimental study, including 1504 records with 13 attributes. The resulting model has sufficient performance indicators for its use in clinical practice for predicting the development of heart failure in the early stages.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Methodological Approaches to the Creation of Cyber-Physical Systems in the Production of Entomophages
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is devoted to the issue of determining theoretical and methodological approaches to the creation of cyber-physical systems in the production of entomophages, using at the same time the results of preliminary studies on the development and implementation of intelligent information processing algorithms in the management of the production of entomophages based on correlation-regression analysis, fuzzy logic, neural networks, cognitive analysis; cyberphysical, system and precedent approaches, data mining, semantic modeling; at the same time, the object of research was the production processes of entomophages and production management systems; in order to increase the efficiency of management of the production of entomophages, the following were developed: the structure of the cyber-physical control system for the production of entomophages, the algorithm for managing the production of entomophages, a predicate semantic network for the participation of a specialist biotechnologist in the processes of production management, a diagram of the precedents of the interaction of the biological component based on the results of the data mining and means of communication in the intelligent decision-making support system, the main stages of construction an intelligent decision-making support system; the considered approaches ensure an increase in the efficiency of management of the biotechnical production of entomophages and is the basis of further research on the intensification of this production with the use of modern intellectual information technologies.

articleTitle: Efficiency Analysis of Air Traffic Under the Risk of Airspace Use
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Operation of modern air transportation system is grounded on efficient use of airspace and available network of flight routes. Air traffic flow management takes into account airspace performance and separation minimums within the flight routes network. In case of the closed part of airspace, air traffic flow is reconfigured and directed over closed volumes. However, such action increases the load of neighbor areas and may affect the safety of aviation. In the paper we propose to use trajectory data obtained under Automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast (ADS-B) for efficiency analysis of particular air connections performed by different pre-planned trajectories. Variation of actual trajectories by performing unique flight plan is a result of different flight techniques and acting errors of airplane positioning sensors. Parameters of total flight time and length of airplane trajectory are used in connection between airports efficiency analysis. A Kernel probability density function is used to fit input trajectory data histogram. Efficiency analysis has been performed to study losses from Belarus airspace closing on March 23, 2021. Results indicate about increasing flight time in 30 minutes approximately for air connection between Ukraine and airports in Northern side.

articleTitle: Synthesis Method for Sensor Systems and UAVs in the Problem of Monitoring Lightning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents the results of the development of a lightning monitoring method based on the synthesis of sensor systems and UAVs. A variant of the hardware-software model of the system for monitoring thunderstorm activity zones is presented. The integrated use of a space-time reference system based on navigation satellite technologies, a sensor system for determining the spatial characteristics of thunderstorm activity zones, as well as data exchange based on wireless technologies creates conditions for improving the safety of manned and unmanned aerial vehicles. The results of a natural experiment are presented. The thunderstorm detection range is at least 27 km, which exceeds the set restrictions of 10 km and 15 km to execute flights in accordance with the VFR and IFR rules, respectively. The resulting results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Protocols Using Single Quantum Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Currently, theoretical and experimental work in the field of quantum cryptography is being carried out in many research centers around the world. Over the past two decades since the start of active research, many quantum cryptographic protocols have been proposed, a significant number of laboratory experiments have been performed on their practical implementation, important work has been done to prove the resistance of the proposed protocols to certain types of attacks, and the first commercial quantum key distribution systems have been developed. However, there are still many tasks and problems in the field of quantum cryptography, the solution of which is of great scientific and technical importance. So, in particular, such a promising direction as quantum protocols for direct secure communication requires further development, allowing, under certain conditions, to transfer secret information without encryption, both between two and between a large number of users. Currently, such protocols have been developed using two-and three-particle entangled states, but there are almost no similar protocols with entangled states of a larger number of qubits that do not require large quantum memory for their implementation and, at the same time, have a large information capacity. Therefore, the development of new quantum direct secure communication protocols with increased information capacity, the analysis of their resistance to attacks, as well as the determination of the best protocols according to the criteria of resistance and information capacity.

articleTitle: Accounting and Analytical Aspect of Reflection of Foreign Economic Security of Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article analyzes parameters of foreign economic security, which characterize effectiveness of foreign economic security mechanism of Ukraine, taking into account impact on national economy by a set of external and internal factors. The basic principles and factors of foreign economic security and potential threats to vital national interests are revealed. The indicative assessment system of foreign economic security of Ukraine according to the system of indicators taking into account domestic statistics and world experience for the period 2002 - 2019 was scientifically substantiated. Specific measures have been suggested to prevent the identified threats to Ukraine's foreign economic security. Hypotheses concerning existence of positive and negative statistical dependence between number of socio-economic indicators of foreign trade activity were formulated, correlation coefficients between them were defined and interpreted. Statistical significance of relationship between indicators of foreign economic activity and indicators of economic security were established, based on correlation-regression analysis.

articleTitle: A Method of Estimating the Duration of a Subscriber's Waiting in the IP Telephony Call Center Queue
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of inbound call service of modern call centre, increasing the number of satisfied customers, unique solutions are being developed that allow, for example, estimating the average duration of a call in queue, etc. It is the development of such a method that was the subject of this article. The method developed makes it possible to inform queue subscribers with an accuracy of at least 90% about the approximate waiting time. This allows the subscriber to plan his or her time more effectively and be more satisfied with the quality of service provided by the call centre. The proposed method is based on the collection and analysis of call-center operators' work statistics of previous periods. This, in turn, can also contribute to proper planning of the number of operators required.

articleTitle: Development of a Telemedicine System Module for Automated Human Movement Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper devoted to the development of a telemedicine module for patient movement analysis was developed. A mobile application can be used in sports medicine to monitor patients who restore motion activity at home and as a fitness application during online classes to control the correct exercises. The proposed method allows the limitations imposed by NAT. The developed mobile application prototype was tested. It creates the coordinates of nodes of the virtual skeleton, which tracking by the motion analysis module.

articleTitle: Application of the BRW VaR methodology for assessing market risk in financial markets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The current study focuses attention on the testing of the BRW method for the determination of the VaR concept, as a quantitative measure of market risk. The object of the study are forty-four stock indices representing the capital markets of the respective countries from all geographical continents. In practice, the indicated toolkit is a kind of revision of the generally known methods for calculating the VaR methodology, parametric, historical simulation and Monte Carlo simulation. By definition, BRW VaR is a methodology for determining market risk, constructed as a combination of historical simulation and the exponential smoothing approach. In the specialized scientific literature, it is observed that the results of the application of BRW VaR are a more accurate measurer compared to the historical simulation approach. In line with this, in this scientific paper, we will verify and respectively test how accurate the BRW VaR methodology is as a risk measurer compared to the historical simulation under the conditions of highly changing financial markets. The results of the empirical study inform about the presence of an underestimation of the maximum loss in the determination of VaR by the historical simulation compared to the BRW VaR. The indicated regularity can be seen when testing the model at three different confidence intervals (5%, 2.5%, 1%).

articleTitle: A Secure State of the OSI-Based Distributed System in the Context of Evaluating Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A scientific rationale for cyber security measures is to be based on the use of a particular objective function. This objective function has to integrate and meaningfully describe: the dynamic context of a cyber attack in an operating OSI-based distributed system; the interrelation between hardware- and software-related causes leading to inoperability of system components, including those stemming from cyber attacks; unpredictable parameters (place, time, tools) of authorized information access which causes a violation of a security policy. To introduce the above aspects, we propose to bring into use the concept of a secure state of the OSI-based distributed system, as well as its formal indicator, i.e. a probability of a system security state during check time.

Author Keywords: probability of a secure state of a cyber security object component

articleTitle: Mobile Applications Use for Business Growth
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article aims to study the essence and prospects of using mobile application technology in the information space and modern business. The research is focused on the essence of mobile applications. It is found that the mobile application is a specialized software designed to work on smartphones, tablets and other mobile devices that is installed mainly through the official stores of the manufacturer or developer of the mobile operating system, and they are aimed at optimizing and solving user tasks. It is noted that there are several approaches to the technical implementation of applications for mobile devices, namely - native, hybrid, and progressive web. Among the most used types for businesses should note the main applications for automating processes, increasing productivity and collaboration, and providing online services. The functionality of mobile applications has been analyzed and several concepts for mobile management are presented and compared to create a model for effective mobile management as the main contribution of this paper. Conclusions are drawn about the feasibility of using mobile applications in the activities.

articleTitle: Detection of Small Drones in Thermal Infrared Range Using YOLOv5 Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Small drones have become widespread due to their affordability and ease of operation. In this regard the number of offenses with their use is growing. Small drones are widely used in military conflicts also. The task of detecting small drones is not easy and relevant. The small size of the drone makes it difficult to detect by radar, optical and acoustic methods. Therefore a combination of these methods is most often used. This paper discusses the problem of detecting small drones in thermal infrared (IR) range. The aim of study is to evaluate the effectiveness of YOLOv5 neural networks for detecting such objects in IR images under various conditions.

articleTitle: Security Measures of Protection for Banking Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: its common Security breaches and other threats can harm a bank’s brand and bottom line. Therefore, banks and other financial institutions must implement sufficient security controls and Information security governance frameworks (ISGF) to guarantee that only authorized individuals can access sensitive data. This study analyzes the risks associated with the banking industry's reliance on information security systems. There is a proposal for a framework to control information security (ISGF). The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27002 is one example of a widely adopted framework for controlling data privacy and integrity. Many information security frameworks, including ISSA, FFIEC, PCI-DSS, COBIT, and others, have explained in detail. Each of the three tiers of the information security governance framework (ISG)—strategic, tactical, and technical—are subdivided into sublevels table In this, All detailed descriptions of each part of the proposed ISG is mentioned in the table. This structure is going to be use by the banking industry. In addition to the different types of ISG, all types of breaches that threats the security of the financial institutes are explained in brief form. This document details the roles and responsibilities of each ISG member and how they contribute to the overall effectiveness of the ISGF. All possible invasions have avoided with the help of the suggested measures. Gaining strong Information security governance framework was one of the recommendations provided in this study for improving the actual banking system's environment and handling the security problems.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models for Assessing the Reliability of Processes of Automated Control of the Main Gas Pipeline, Taking into Account the "Human Factor"
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of ensuring the reliability and high efficiency of processes of automated control of the main gas pipeline is considered. The necessity of orientation on the human-system approach in the construction of control systems of gas transportation processes is justified. The reasons for erroneous actions of human operator when controlling the processes of gas transportation are analyzed. Reliability and efficiency indicators, which should be taken into account when building systems of ergonomic support for human operators, have been determined. Mathematical models for analyzing the reliability of control of the main gas pipeline, based on the use of the apparatus of functional networks of Professor Anatoly Gubinsky, have been developed. Software for modeling the activities of operators-technologists in the control system of the main gas pipeline has been developed. Models and software are appropriate to be used for inclusion in decision support systems for the management of gas transportation processes.

articleTitle: Sleptsov Net Processor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, the universal Sleptsov net (SN) is considered as a prototype of the Sleptsov net processor. The program, written in Sleptsov net language preserving concurrency of an application area, runs on the Sleptsov net processor. We use the places, transitions, and arcs of SN as input data, and then we can get different levels of output data. Mainly two variants of software Sleptsov net processor, single and multi-thread, have been developed, its computation complexity evaluated, benchmarks implemented which acknowledge complexity evaluations. This processor implements the concurrent firing of transitions in multiple instances in a single step, provides fast computations and promises ultra-high performance. In addition, the SN processor adopts the parallelization concept based on OpenMP, studies and implements the operation on the parallel structure, and improves the operation efficiency of the processor.

articleTitle: GPS Usage Analysis for Angular Orientation Practical Tasks Solving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: New models of dual antenna Global Positioning System (GPS) receivers with improved characteristics have appeared recently on the world market. Thus the scope of problems which might be solved has been significantly expanded. The paper considers the possibility of using modern dual antenna receivers to solve some practical problems of angular orientation. An experimental study of dual antenna GPS receiver models using ALIGN© technology from NovAtel is being carried out. Effective methods for improving the accuracy of a dual antenna GPS receiver are proposed. The subject of the article is the study of the possibility of using dual-antenna GPS systems for solving practical problems of navigation and steering. The study used the methods of experimental research, experiment planning, as well as statistical processing of the data. The results obtained make it possible to formulate practical recommendations on the use of dual-antenna systems for solving specific problems of navigation and steering.

articleTitle: Economic and Mathematical Model of Actual Mining Ore Lasting and Information System for Management of Mining Work According to the Criterion of Achieving Their Economic Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An urgent problem in the development of iron ore deposits is the need for effective management of the production process of ore mining. The importance of this management is explained by the direct dependence of obtaining the necessary economic and technical results predicted in the working projects of mining units from the effectiveness of managing the project implementation process in practice. The high level of complexity of the tasks of managing the production process requires the development and use of a system of automated control of the production process APCS at a mining enterprise. All such automated control systems already developed at present are aimed at solving only particular tasks of managing certain areas of enterprise activity and are not integrated with each other. This complicates the implementation of this type of production and the efficiency of making managerial decisions on its preparation and implementation. At present, the authors are developing such a process control system, taking into account the requirements for the integration of its technological elements and ensuring consistency in solving the problems of managing the production process at underground iron ore mining enterprises. The methodological provisions on the basis of which the automated control system is being developed provides for a unified fundamental and methodological approach, mathematical, organizational and technical bases that ensure the full integration of its structural elements, consistency in management and organizational decisions. The key element of the automated control system is the computer-aided design system (CAD) of mining units, as the basic elements of the production process at the enterprise. This CAD is designed to solve one of the most difficult tasks in ensuring the functioning of a mining enterprise - the choice of the optimal variant of the mining system for mining units according to the criteria for ensuring the highest economic efficiency of ore extraction. The basic element of CAD is a subsystem for economic and mathematical modeling of the process of developing ore reserves of mining blocks / panels. The totality of these objects are the main production elements of mining enterprises and it is in them that the extraction of ore mass from the ore reserve and the formation of its qualitative and physical and mechanical characteristics are carried out. The process of mining the ore mass forms the main part of the cost of commercial iron ore products produced from it. Based on the decisions made in the working drafts of the set of mining units, the production and technological system of mining enterprises is functioning. The system for managing its functioning organizes this process in such a way as to ensure the development of their reserves with the characteristics, parameters and economic results provided for by the working projects that are developed using CAD. The solution of design problems in CAD is one of the key elements of the entire system for organizing the development process. The authors have developed a block diagram of the cyclical algorithm of this organization, reflecting the logical sequence of management stages and their relationship. This algorithm is the basis of the functional model of the process control system. The described APMS continues to be developed and refined with new structural modules and software blocks. These developments represent the materials of the methodological, organizational, mathematical and program nature of the automated control system, expanding its capabilities. The largest of these developments are: a methodology for computer-aided design of mining enterprises, which determines the structure, functions and operation of the automated control systems of these enterprises, CAD for technological processes of underground mining of iron ores, methodological foundations and rules for ensuring the safety of mining ore deposits, a methodology and software for normalizing extraction indicators ores.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Fuzzy Extractor for Generating Strong Keys from Biometric Face Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Biometric techniques have traditionally been used in various cybersecurity applications. For instance, some user authentication systems use biometric facial images, fingerprints, iris images, vein patterns, and much more. Most of these applications store biometric features copies (or data derived from these features). Authentication is carried out based on the results of comparing the presented biometric images with the reference ones. However, if the storage is compromised, biometric personal data will be lost and this significantly limits the scope of biometric techniques. Fuzzy extractors solve this problem. Instead of reference biometric data, fuzzy extractors extract cryptographically strong keys (secret bit strings, passwords) that are used to authenticate users. In addition, the extracted keys can be used as a source of entropy for various cryptographic mechanisms (encryption, electronic signature, etc.). In this paper, we propose a fuzzy extractor for generating cryptographically strong keys from biometric images of a human face. Our extractor uses biometric image preprocessing using deep learning methods, as well as code-based cryptosystems that provide a post-quantum (quantum-resistant) level of security.

articleTitle: The Role of Infocommunication Technologies in International Tourism Industry Development
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The active spread of digital technologies, in our new world, which is constantly evolving, leads to the evolution of business processes in many areas of the economy. Internet is strongly influencing on the most dynamic areas of activity, that are based on the exchange of information and territorial disunity of the buyer, seller and producer of goods or services, such as banking, tourism and international trade. Now it is difficult to imagine at least one sphere of human activity in which information systems and technologies are not used. They make it possible to apply a wide range of possibilities for processing and presenting information, and the field of tourism is no exception. The fact is that the tourism business is not only one of the most dynamic; it is also extremely saturated with various information. In our opinion, all achievements and achievements in this area of the economy directly depend on the speed of information exchange, its relevance, and timeliness of receipt, adequacy and completeness. The process of information exchange in the field of tourism is directly related to the main functions of a tourist enterprise: information for the purpose of forming a certain database, as well as for the further promotion of the created tourist product in the market environment; the tourist agency - receives information in the form of ready-made tourist products from the tour operator, and then transfers the tourist products to the next subject of market relations; the tourist - receives information, formed by the tour operator, transferred to the travel agent, consumes the tourist product, and then supplements the information flow with its feedback and suggestions.

articleTitle: Internet of Things as a Key Technology for Developing Smart Tourism Destinations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The rapid expansion of urbanization has presented cities with a variety of challenges, which they have overcome through the application of cutting-edge ICT, turning them into smart cities. Creating a unified technological platform to serve tourists, locals, and businesses transforms smart cities into smart tourism destinations (STD). The Internet of Things (IoT), which provides various opportunities and applications for analyzing, forecasting, and planning the tourism environment, is a fundamental technology for the STD's development. The begging point for building the STD is the definition of an IoT-based architecture. The purpose of the paper is to explore the application of IoT in STD and outline a sui table IoT architectural framework. The main method of research is the systematic review of the scientific literature on the subject. The publication also presents findings from an author's research on the state of digital transformation in destination Veliko Tarnovo. As a result of the research the most essential IoT applications and technologies for STD are outlined, an IoT architectural framework that best fits STD characteristics is provided, and the risks and challenges of implementing IoT in smart destinations are summarized.

articleTitle: Factors for Improving Ukraine’s Information Security System in the Context of the Russian-Ukrainian Neo-Imperial War: Integrative Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the factors for improving Ukraine’s information security system in the context of the Russian-Ukrainian neo-imperial war. The integrative approach enables a holistic vision of Ukraine’s information security system and provides relevant tools for transdisciplinary information security research with due consideration of close correlation of its subsystems and key dimensions. Understanding the phenomenon of information and psychology terrorism and cyberterrorism makes it possible to prevent threats that can disrupt the stability of the society and challenge the foundations of the national security as a whole.

articleTitle: Method for Determining the Magnitude of Mechanical Oscillations of Piezoelectric Bimorph Elements of a Three-Dimensional Piezoelectric Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An analysis of the structural construction of existing three-dimensional piezoelectric accelerometers is carried out, in which the sensitivity vectors are directed against the measured inertial force and, therefore, it becomes possible to measure linear inertia and acceleration within small limits, which include elements that create additional electromagnetic fields and complicate their designs. In addition, due to the lack of a position sensor of the object of measurement and the electronic control circuit, the functionality of such accelerometers is limited, due to the lack of an integrator for integrating acceleration, the measurement of the speed of moving objects is not provided, due to the rigid fastening of piezoelectric sensitive elements through their bases, in the process measurements, they create interference signals, the amplitude of which in many cases exceeds the amplitude of the useful signal, which does not ensure the reliability of the measured acceleration or speed, and due to the presence of sensitive piezoelectric elements that are more rigid and require relatively large mechanical forces to generate signals when the object of measurement is moving acceleration and speed in automatic mode, which reduces the sensitivity of piezoelectric accelerometers. In this regard, a new design and control circuit of a three-dimensional piezoelectric accelerometer and an analytical method have been developed that allow determining the magnitude of mechanical vibrations of a three-dimensional piezoelectric accelerometer to measure the dynamic parameters of moving objects in automatic mode and in real time.

articleTitle: Real-Time Page Extraction for Document Digitization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analyzes existing methods of processing photo and video images to solve the problem of extracting pages from a video stream. The concept of an algorithm for video segmentation for use in real-time optical character recognition (OCR) tasks is proposed. Possibilities for implementation of the approach, potential shortcomings, and challenges, as well as ways to solve them, are described. The algorithm can become the basis for other algorithms for digitization and analysis of printed and handwritten texts, which can later be used for future research in the field. The novelty of the approach is the use of video semantics algorithms to solve the topical question of text recognition.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity and Data Stability Analysis of IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: the aspects of analysis of modern cyber threats and their stability and reliability problems in Internet of Things devices, as well as stability risks of Internet of Things devices arising in modern personal users devices and Industrial Internet of Things systems, were considered in this paper. The main factors of influencing of the informational intrusions, data stability and also the consequences of their successful manifestation are considered in these papers. The approaches of more stable and secure decision for data environments in IoT were proposed. Development prospects and an approach to reliability assessment of Internet of Things systems and personal usersdevices are considered.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model for Determining Optimal Size Mining Blocks Iron Ore Mining According to the Creterea Economic Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Sustainable development is one of the priority areas of society. However, the replacement of natural minerals with artificial ones, in particular iron ore, has not yet taken place. Therefore, the authors of scientific work are constantly looking for optimal ways to use natural resources, including iron ore. Thus, the following problems of iron ore mining were considered in the works of the authors: 1) parametric resonance in the process of movement of hoisting vessels in the trenches of ore and coal mines; 2) expert system of selection of competitive options of systems of underground development of ore deposits; 3) the automated system for selection for optimal solution for the process of iron ore mining based on artificial intelligence methodology. However, another problem of iron ore mining has not been considered by the authors - an integrated economic and mathematical model the geomechanical state of rock mass at ultrahigh depths and to determine the optimal geometric dimensions of structural elements of mining blocks. This model is developed on the basis of the method of dimensionless functional characteristics for calculating the dimensions of the structural elements of the block, ensuring their stability. The authors have expanded the capabilities of this method by introducing into its mathematical apparatus elements that make it possible to perform vibrational economic and mathematical calculations of an optimization nature to find the sizes of block elements that are optimal according to economic criteria, ensuring the simultaneous achievement of the necessary stability of the block elements for the entire period of ore mining in the block and the maximum possible economic efficiency of developing its reserve in specific geomechanical and economic conditions for carrying out mining operations.

articleTitle: Processes and Structure of Student Software Engineering Organization at Educational Institution
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents the generic model of a student engineering organization. The model consists of the optimal structure and processes of the organization. Results of the research are based on the analysis of the experience of the creation, leading, and management of the student software engineering organization, called PNUdev, which functions at Vasyl Stefanyk Precarpathian National University. The model might be used for the creation of similar engineering organizations in different educational institutions and as a point of further research on the explored topic.

articleTitle: Methods of Digital-To-Analog Conversion for Reproduction of Sound Waves
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper we are considering a method of digital-to-analog conversion with which it is possible to implement the transfer of sound information using air flows generated by fans. The architecture of the software-hardware complex with which this is done and the algorithm with all stages of data preparation, processing and transmission are also considered. Experiments conducted to verify the effectiveness of using this method in real life are also described. People participated in the experiment, who needed to identify the class of sound that is reproduced by means of the created complex. For this, the combination of air flows for each class must be previously learned by a person. Also, a separate stage of experiments with sounds typical of wartime was conducted. The results were formed, in which it was found that certain combinations of the duration of sounds and their count can indeed be correctly identified by a person.

articleTitle: Correlation of RFID Technology Among Other Encryption Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the last few years, the most rapid development has been a new direction in the development of electronics - the so-called Radio Frequency Identification technology. This technology allows, using an electronic label, to which includes an electronic chip as an information carrier and a reader. At the current stage of economic development, the search for new methods of improving logistics processes is directly related to the ideas of computerization. A detailed description of one of the methods is Radio Frequency Identification technology, which ensures transparency of information. In all parts of the value chain from suppliers to end consumers. The article presents a comparative analysis of the main technical and economic indicators of barcode and Radio Frequency Identification technologies, which determines the principles of operation of the basic Radio Frequency Identification system and its components. The document describes a detailed comparison of the two methods and an experiment to assess the impact of the operating conditions of the Radio Frequency Identification system.

articleTitle: Event Model Algorithm with Microservice Architecture Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The Event-driven architectures (EDA) are gaining popularity for a reason. Scalability in building isolated microservices is a paradigm that many businesses are constantly striving for, and event-driven architecture is built with that in mind. With innovative tools such as Kafka and RabbitMQ, event-driven architectures are becoming more flexible, versatile, and robust to satisfy a wide range of business needs. However, powerful tool also comes at a price: a high learning curve and rather complicated initial setup. However, once such a structure is in place, the benefits are clear as data is transmitted with lower latency and higher throughput. So why not use an event-driven architecture? In the work, an algorithm for transition to the use of EDA is proposed for a successful transition to such an architecture.

articleTitle: Agent Modeling of Educational Motivation in Online Learning Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to agent modeling the features of student learning motivation in online learning conditions. Maintaining motivation plays a special role during the introduction of distance learning in connection with the coronavirus epidemic. To analyze the features of motivation in different learning conditions agent model of the student motivation has been used. The effectiveness of the model was tested in both offline and online learning. The results of modeling showed that the influence of the main motivational components in the conditions of offline learning varies from primary school to higher education. The youngest students are best motivated to learn in a situation where the inner desire to learn something new is constantly supported by external stimulation. In primary school, the motivating influence of teachers and parents gradually decreases, but both the negative and positive influence of an important environment (friends, reference adults) increases. Adolescents have clearly defined learning goals. The impact of online learning on this category of students is quite controversial. The study has found mixed trends - both an increase in motivation for learning and a sharp decrease. The first group is quietly moving to online learning, making extensive use of the Internet. The second either completely lose motivation to learn or shows unstable motivation, which either sharply decreases, then just as sharply increases. Agent modeling technologies allows tracking the conditions under which stimulation will be change student learning motivation.

articleTitle: Impact of Information Technology on Cultural and Cognitive Tourism Development in Ukraine in Terms of COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article analyzes the impact of information technology on the development of cultural and cognitive tourism in Ukraine. Attention is paid to the degree of introduction of information technologies in museums of Ukraine, the peculiarities of the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on this process. It is established that the world's leading museums are actively expanding their presence in the virtual world, by transferring communication and certain types of work into social networks, sites, based on new methods of content: virtual tours, video tours. Being given the limited access to the museum, due to the global COVID-19 pandemic, this gives them the advantage of maintaining an audience, conducting information campaigns and meeting the recreational and cultural needs of citizens. The analysis of information activity of Ukrainian museums on the example of national tourist resources, sites and social pages of individual museums showed a gradual growth of this type of work since 2017. Cluster analysis of information activity of cultural and cognitive tourism objects made it possible to distinguish four centers: East; West; Southern; Northern.

articleTitle: Interaction Model and Phase States at Frequency Resource Allocation in a Grouping of Radio-Electronic Equipment of 5G Mobile Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper proposes a dynamic model of multiple nonlinear electromagnetic interactions when using the radio resource of a group of radio electronic means of the 5G-NewRadio mobile communication network. The model describes the electromagnetic environment of multiple nonlinear interactions of a group of electronic means in the state space based on n-elements of a complex system, which takes into account the nature of interelement connections and phase states taking into account the intensity of its elements. The analysis of phase states of grouping of 5G-NewRadio electronic means depending on intensity of nonlinear interactions of its elements at which the network will be able to function without deterioration of qualitative indicators, in the conditions of optimum distribution of a radio resource is carried out. The dynamics of nonequilibrium states of groups of 5G-NewRadio mobile networks at different values of the intensity of interactions of electronic means, the total nature of which is displayed by the normalized value of the signal / (interference + noise) ratio, is demonstrated. It is shown that the nonequilibrium state of the 5G-NewRadio mobile communication system occurs at a normalized value of the interaction intensity greater than 1.4. It is shown that with the help of the proposed mathematical model, which demonstrates the dynamics of multiple electromagnetic nonlinear interactions of radio electronic means of grouping at different parameters and the nature of the intensity of their interactions, it is possible to analyze the 5G-NewRadio network in the future.

articleTitle: Neural Networks: Training with Backpropagation and the Gradient Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work involves research and analysis of the topic of learning algorithms of neural networks. This paper presents network learning that is performed by regenerating neural connections. This type of learning uses the back-propagation method. The concept of such a term as the activation function and its features are introduced. Based on some of the given characteristics, a detailed analysis of the choice of each of them for a specific task is provided. The principle of building a neural network using backpropagation and using gradient descent to optimize error detection is considered. The study shows the shortcomings of the backpropagation algorithm and presents methods of backpropagation that eliminate this algorithm's defects. A simple four-layer neural network using backpropagation and gradient descent is investigated to classify handwritten numbers if they were part of the MNIST dataset. The advantages and disadvantages of this type of network are given. The study presents an analysis for better application of the Sigmoid or Relu activation function.

articleTitle: Information Technologies and Social Networks in Business: Integrated Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article considers the peculiarities of Information Technologies implementations in the business activity of modern enterprises. The Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems specifics use to companies maintain their interactions with customers were defined. Customer Relationship Management systems as special software for managing customers’ activities, automating communications, and streamlining business processes were analyzed. The necessity of their integration with social networks was substantiated. Social networks used by Ukrainians and their specific data were analyzed. The ways to create a complex business ecosystem with integrated Information Technologies were presented.

articleTitle: The Method of Increasing the Energy Saving of a Constellation of Small Satellites of a Satellite Network with a Distributed Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work solves a scientific and practical task - the development of models for the integration of wireless information and energy transmission technology into the infrastructure of a satellite network based on small satellites using algorithms and artificial intelligence tools in conditions of high dynamics of changes in the probabilistic-temporal characteristics of information flows and conflicting requirements for quality of service. A conceptual model of the integration of the technology of wireless transmission of information and energy into the infrastructure of a satellite network based on small satellites is proposed, which provides the necessary infrastructure to support the developed intelligent algorithms for managing information and communication flows. Models and tools have been developed for the analysis and management of resources in a low-orbit satellite system based on a distributed satellite for the transmission of information and energy.

Author Keywords: wireless transmission of information and energy

articleTitle: The Use of Infocommunication Components of Mechanical Trading Systems to Manage the Financial Security of Business Entities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 9th International Conference on Problems of Infocommunications, Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Modern trends in the use of information and communication technologies to ensure the financial security of economic entities were determined. The distribution of a large sample of enterprises by industry according to the level of financial security (on the verge of bankruptcy, stable and financially stable) using the Altman model was proposed. The potential of using mechanical trading systems within the scope of investment activities on virtual asset exchanges by domestic enterprises in order to increase profit as a component of the Altman coefficient was revealed. The hypothesis was proposed and confirmed: a positive impact on the company’s profit leads to an increase in the level of its financial security. The effectiveness of using a trading strategy based on the commodity channel index was proved through the simulation of trades in virtual assets on a selected fragment of retrospective data using the developed mechanical trading system. The advantages of managing the financial security of enterprises using the proposed info-communication components of mechanical trading systems was demonstrated.
